meta.description: Minimal offline data package for ResilientRoute. Contains enough data to run the demo without any network connection.
meta.source: See data/PROVENANCE.md for full source tracking

includes.network: Minimal transit network: 16 MTR stations, 4 bus stops, 2 piers, 13 lines, 7 walk links
includes.calendar: Service calendar with 3 schedule types and 2026 public holidays
includes.routes: 8 seed candidate routes for TAW->ADM with 2 persona picks
includes.sim: 1 placeholder SimResult (10k population, guided vs unguided)

notes: All data in this package is labelled with provenance (real/real-derived/simulated).
No external API calls are made in offline mode.
LLM is disabled by default. Route queries use deterministic logic.
The demo scenario (TAW->ADM, ERL cross-harbour closed) works fully offline.
For full functionality, set OFFLINE_MODE=false and configure LLM in .env.
